payload.title: Content with notebooks
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to create content using Jupyter Notebooks, integrating code blocks and their outputs into a book format. It highlights the use of MyST markdown for embedding images, HTML, and mathematical expressions. The notebook includes a sample Matplotlib code to visualize data with a custom color cycle and legend. The code generates a plot using random data, showcasing the flexibility of Jupyter Notebooks in combining narrative and computational content.
